issue.body:
for this code :

from starlette.config import Config
from starlette.datastructures import URL, Secret

config = Config(".env")

URI: URL = config("URI", cast=URL, default="")
PASSWORD: Secret = config("PASSWORD", cast=Secret, default="")

when run mypy check, it failed:
error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "object", variable has type "URL")  [assignment]
error: Incompatible types in assignment (expression has type "object", variable has type "Secret")  [assignment]
issue.title: mypy check failed for URL/Secret typing from Config
